title: Regent-X Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Arai Regent-X Gloss Black is engineered for everyday agility, rapid ventilation, and effortless usability, delivering responsive balance and confident road feel. Featuring a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) architecture at 1416g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~87 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Excellent entry into the premium Arai lineup, focusing on comfort.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Arai's signature 'Perfect Fit' system; designed for Intermediate Oval head shape with a snug, secure cheek pad closure and minimal gap around the temples.

technical_analysis: Features Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection paired with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports. The interior utilizes One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Arai Regent-X Gloss Black: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports and One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Arai Regent-X Gloss Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Arai Regent-X Gloss Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Arai's Full Face lineup, the Regent-X Gloss Black brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Arai Regent-X Gloss Black represents Arai's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Arai Regent-X Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
